steps.title: Give each piece a job
steps.where: Read here · no changes
actions: A physical server is a real computer. ESXi runs directly on it and shares CPU, memory, disks and network connections among virtual machines. Each VM behaves like its own computer.
vCenter is the central office that manages several ESXi hosts. Its web interface is the vSphere Client at https://your-vcenter/ui. A single host has its own ESXi Host Client at https://your-host/ui.
A datastore stores VM files. A virtual disk is one file-backed disk belonging to a VM. A port group is a named network connection choice. A template is a prepared master used to create new VMs.

actions: In stage 1, name the appliance VM, set its root password locally, choose the documented deployment size, datastore and network. Enter the planned FQDN, address, prefix/mask, gateway and DNS. Review everything before Finish.
